rule_0.statement: THE COMMAND-ADAPTER LAW. The walk's own derived plant law x_off = v * t_stance/2 (t_stance = DUTY_SAMPLED*T_CYCLE = 0.683*0.71 s, t_half = 0.2424650 s) is the ONE measured-live injection surface (TypeB-P1 receipt, surface B: onset 10 ticks, graded dose response, reaches the plant; surfaces A/C/D dead). THE CLAIM: surfacing that surface as a declared first-class command channel -- the commanded velocity REPLACES the v argument of the derived relation at its two plant-target sites (fore_xoff(), the hind step fire) -- gives a learned layer graded, sustained, veto-free velocity authority INSIDE the walk's own measured envelope, with zero new constants and the reflex layer untouched (the envelope/entry/reach machinery and every budget keep the MEASURED v; the learned layer never disables a reflex).
rule_0.prediction: Held commands below the walk's own operating ceiling produce a monotone dose-response in the achieved body velocity with machinery onset within one clock slot (<= 15 ticks), veto-free for >= 100 ticks, and the seed-pinned run rides its baseline class to its baseline horizon; commands above the ceiling meet the existing annulus clamps and the existing budgets, lawfully, with no adapter-invented refusal.

falsifiers_declared_before_the_run.F-FENCE-ADAPTER: FIRES if, with the channel UNEXERCISED, the adapter build differs from the ship bytes by ONE byte: stdout sha != 71065ac54fa988704ce29cd79cfb5cdbe0d4e2eab3f7db69b10d4b8d94517592, plain != trace stdout, patched trace stderr != the pristine 30821ef7 trace stderr, the [0,65] trace window not line-identical, or the named ticks 98/107/142/160 not byte-exact (the wave-38 fence convention). The interface must be INVISIBLE when unused.
falsifiers_declared_before_the_run.F-COMMAND-AUTHORITY-2: FIRES unless ALL of: (a) MACHINERY ONSET <= 15 ticks after the issue tick (the first plant-law consumption under command; the M2 onset class); (b) VETO-FREE HORIZON >= 100 ticks post-onset for EVERY in-band run (no budget refusal within 100 ticks of onset); (c) GRADED: the achieved steady-state velocity over matched post-onset windows is monotone non-strict in the commanded velocity across R1<R2<R3 with a total spread >= 0.05 m/s (the receipt's graded bar); (d) STABILITY: R4 (seed pinned from tick 0) refuses, if it refuses, with the BASELINE class gait_positional_correction_budget at tick >= 300.
falsifiers_declared_before_the_run.F-COMMAND-ENVELOPE: FIRES if the out-of-band probe R5 (1.30 m/s, the TypeB receipt's own A-command value) is absorbed byte-identically (the command does not reach the plant path) OR dies in a refusal class the ship machinery does not own (the adapter inventing a refusal). Passes only by the EXISTING budgets/clamps governing.
falsifiers_declared_before_the_run.F-ZOH-CLOCK: FIRES if R6 (the command re-issued at 20 Hz, every 15 ticks, per the Astra round-4 interface clock) differs by one byte from R2 (single issue + hold): the hold state is value-only, so a constant command re-issued at the 20 Hz decision clock MUST be byte-equivalent to one issue.

the_band_mine_measured.method: the ship trace's [dvf] lines carry per-tick per-leg D (the fore chain's reach) and the tgt/sh seats; amax = sqrt(D^2-h^2), h = shoulder height above the plant; stance-mode ticks only (t >= 60, the post-capture walk)
the_band_mine_measured.ship_graze_fact: 378/834 stance leg-ticks carry |off| > amax within print precision (median excess ~1e-7 m, the graze class): the ship walk plants AT its own reach edge at the seed -- extra reach is clamped away, which is the M2 B-gentle absorption measured. ABOVE-seed commands therefore buy clamps, not reach.
the_band_mine_measured.band_declaration: THE MEASURED ENVELOPE (ceiling = the walk's own demonstrated operating point): [0, 0.763625] m/s. The central annulus bound (0.9334 m/s) is reported as context; the seed is the ceiling because the ship walk demonstrably carries it and already grazes its edge there. The in-band test region is [0.15, 0.70]: strictly below the ceiling, spread across the lower band.

interface_spec.channel: commanded_target_velocity_x (m/s, non-negative -- the plant law's own max(0,.) domain); commanded_heading is RESERVED for a later lane (lateral/heading authority is not claimed here)
interface_spec.entry: GaitWalker::configure({"commanded_target_velocity_x": v}) between ticks -- the scene/test harness injects; NOT restart-gated
interface_spec.semantics: ZERO-ORDER HOLD: a new command applies at the next tick boundary and holds until replaced; a constant command re-issued at the 20 Hz decision clock (every 15 ticks over 300 Hz physics) is byte-equivalent to one issue (F-ZOH-CLOCK)
interface_spec.reflex_bound: the command enters ONLY the two derived plant-target x_off sites; the envelope/entry/reach machinery, the capture reflex, and every budget keep the MEASURED v -- the reflex layer never cancels an in-envelope request and the learned layer can never disable a reflex
interface_spec.invisibility: with the channel unexercised every byte of stdout and stderr is the ship byte (F-FENCE-ADAPTER)
